summary: Bribery conviction challenged; inconsistencies in complainant's testimony regarding amount demanded; independent witnesses did not observe money transfer; trap team's account contradicted by physical evidence and witness statements; test solution evidence insufficient without corroboration; reasonable doubt established; prosecution failed to prove demand and acceptance beyond reasonable doubt; Section 20 presumption not triggered; convictions set aside.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellants acquitted; bail bonds cancelled.
